voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.source: ANTAQ observed same-voyage corridors + EU MRV latest IMO intensity with explicit IMO outlier replacement and robust vessel-class and ship-type estimates; same-OD transport-work-weighted intensity and P95-screened, mean-onboard-cargo-weighted distance across complete observed voyages
voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.scenario_distance_weight_definition: mean_onboard_cargo_t = sum(cargo_onboard_t * segment_distance_nm) / sum(segment_distance_nm) = transport_work_tnm / route_distance_nm
voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.segment_cargo_rule: minimum nonnegative onboard reconstruction: initial onboard equals max(0, -minimum cumulative net cargo), then each stop net is applied to the following leg
voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.distance_resolution_rule: positive sea-matrix distance first; retained external port-pair reference second; coordinate haversine fallback for distinct canonical ports only when both are missing or nonpositive

fallback_outlier_policy.vessel_class: use artifact trimmed_mean_1pct; median when trimmed mean is unavailable

segment_summary.voyage_od_observation_policy: one_complete_observation_per_voyage_and_ordered_port_pair; direct_first_then_shortest_distance_km only resolves duplicate occurrences within the same voyage
